The '''Buchich system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system was claimed by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] resources.
